description: Erection of a conservatory to the roof terrace on the first floor, like-for-like replacement of all existing double-glazed rooflights, windows and external glass doors to triple-glazed and installation of an air source heat pump to the rear garden.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: 

Design, Access and Heritage Statement, CGW-MMH-PA-A-2010 Rev E, CGW-MMH-PA-A-1010 Rev B, CGW-MMH-PA-A-2051 Rev B, CGW-MMH-PA-A-2050 Rev E, CGW-MMH-PA-A-2021 Rev C, CGW-MMH-PA-A-2020 Rev D, CGW-MMH-PA-A-2003 Rev E, CGW-MMH-PA-A-2002 Rev E, CGW-MMH-PA-A-2001 Rev E, CGW-MMH-PA-A-2000 Rev F, CGW-MMH-PA-A-2061 Rev B, Method Statement - Replacement and Replication of Artistic Acid-Etched Glazing dated 12/08/2025, CMC_FTN_241201_D01, Daylight and Sunlight Assessment dated December 2024, 29561.PCR.01, CGW-MMH-PA-A-2062 Rev A, CGW-MMH-PA-A-2060 Rev A, CGW-MMH-PA-A-2011 Rev B, CGW-MMH-PA-A-1061 Rev A, CGW-MMH-PA-A-1060 Rev A, CGW-MMH-PA-A-1051 Rev A, CGW-MMH-PA-A-1050 Rev A, CGW-MMH-PA-A-1032 Rev C, CGW-MMH-PA-A-1031 Rev C, CGW-MMH-PA-A-1030 Rev C, CGW-MMH-PA-A-1021 Rev A, CGW-MMH-PA-A-1020 Rev A, CGW-MMH-PA-A-1011 Rev A, CGW-MMH-PA-A-1003 Rev A, CGW-MMH-PA-A-1002 Rev A, CGW-MMH-PA-A-1001 Rev A, CGW-MMH-PA-A-1000 Rev A, CGW-MMH-PA-A-0001 Rev A.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 and D2  of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - The external noise level emitted from plant, machinery or equipment at the development hereby approved shall be lower than the typical existing background noise level by at least 10dBA, or by 15dBA where the source is tonal, as assessed according to BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with all machinery operating together at maximum capacity.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration-isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such. 

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 6 - The existing acid etched chevron pattern glass panes designed by artist Ray Bradley shall be reused where possible and if they cannot be used due to fragility and condition then they shall be replicated as outlined in the 'Method Statement - Replacement and Replication of Artistic Acid-Etched Glazing - Dated 12/08/2025' and retained as such thereafter.

Reason:  To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 7 - Prior to first use of the air source heat pump hereby approved, the active cooling function shall be disabled on the factory setting and the air source heat pump shall be used for the purposes of heating only. 

Reason: To ensure the proposal is energy efficient and sustainable in accordance with policy CC1 and CC2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
